name: Dieter Von Heil
features: fair skin, blonde hair, blue eyes, Germanic features, strong jaw, athletic build, mature face, visible wrinkles, distinguished look, goatee
bio:
A German aristocrat with an intimidating name but a surprisingly gentle driving style. Dieter's smooth inputs preserve tires like nobody else. And yes, his grandfather was an SS official. He doesn't care what people might say about it. He looks at you that way and you immediately quit.

He's got a 1928 SSK that "will honour his ancestors", he said.
